entries.clue: __ Clinton, historic English village that lent its name to a sports car
Mountain West river named for sheep
Clinton said he didn't do it
"Might I suggest ... " + "Since you mentioned it ... " = "I'll be darned!"
Approached old age + Ready to sail = Joined the cause
Little men in the front row
Yell + Bent on getting = Need urgently
Sergeant's order + Type of skate = Get with the program
The Mick succeeded him as Yankee center fielder
Letters after many a general's name
